question: What type of engine is used in the Hansa NG trainer aircraft launched in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rotax 912 iSc3 Sports engine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Hansa NG trainer aircraft is equipped with the **Rotax 912 iSc3 Sports engine**, known for its reliability, efficiency, and lightweight design.
 
• This engine is a four-stroke, fuel-injected engine that supports unleaded aviation fuel and meets stringent emission standards.
 
• The Rotax 912 iSc3 Sports engine delivers **100 horsepower (hp)**, making it suitable for trainer aircraft used in pilot training programs.
 
• It features advanced technology such as electronic fuel injection and digital engine control, enhancing performance and fuel efficiency.
 
• The Rotax engine has been widely adopted in the aviation industry, particularly for ultralight and light-sport aircraft, due to its **low operational costs** and high durability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trainer Aircraft:**

 
 
• Trainer aircraft are specifically designed for pilot training, allowing beginners to learn flight mechanics and navigation.
 
• They are equipped with dual controls to enable instructors to assist trainees during flight.
 
• Modern trainer aircraft often feature advanced avionics to simulate real-world flying conditions.
 
 
 
• **Rotax Engines:**
 
 
• Rotax engines are manufactured by BRP-Rotax GmbH & Co KG, based in Austria.
 
• They are widely used in light aircraft, ultralights, and light-sport aircraft due to their lightweight and reliable performance.
 
• Rotax engines are known for their **low vibration levels**, reduced noise, and compliance with international emission standards.
 
 
 
• **Fuel Efficiency:**
 
 
• The Rotax 912 iSc3 Sports engine's electronic fuel injection system optimizes fuel consumption and reduces emissions.
 
• It is designed to operate efficiently with unleaded aviation gasoline, making it environmentally friendly.
 
 
 
• **Hansa NG Aircraft:**
 
 
• The Hansa NG is an upgraded version of the Hansa series, developed by the National Aerospace Laboratories (NAL), India.
 
• It is a two-seater trainer aircraft designed for general aviation and pilot training.
 
• The aircraft incorporates advanced safety features, improved aerodynamics, and a modern cockpit layout.
